audience: finance and operations teams who extract data from invoices, receipts and other documents with Mindee

useCases.title: See which extraction models your account has
useCases.text: The AI lists the document-extraction models on your account with their id, name and type, so you know if an invoice or receipt model is ready.

useCases.title: Pull the fields out of an invoice or receipt
useCases.text: The AI sends a PDF or image, by public URL or file, to a model and returns the extracted fields, such as invoice number, supplier, date and total. This uses Mindee credits.

useCases.title: Check a document that is still processing
useCases.text: The AI checks the job status of a document (Waiting, Processing, Processed or Failed) and, when it is processed, reads the finished result.

useCases.title: Read the result of a finished extraction again
useCases.text: The AI fetches a completed extraction by its inference id and returns the fields as a compact map, with the raw text if it was requested.
